brief: Why I chose calm over growth and so should you. Capping my AI business at $30k/month MRR instead of chasing $1M. The mental, financial, and lifestyle math of a calm business in 2026.

slots.subtitle: Capping an AI business at $30k MRR instead of chasing unicorn dreams—and sleeping better for it.
slots.preview2: The mental cost of hockey-stick growth
slots.preview3: A 4-day week with zero layoff risk

slots.title: Thirty thousand
slots.subtitle: Why I stopped at $30k MRR when the market demanded I 10×.
slots.insight1Body: Profit margin on $30k solo beats $300k with a team of twelve.
slots.insight2Body: Every hour reclaimed from meetings returns as creative capital.
slots.insight3Body: Small profitable assets sell faster than burning unicorns.
slots.pullQuote: I traded the term sheet for the timetable of my own life.

slots.title: Growth breaks
slots.subtitle: The anxiety of scale is a tax most do not calculate until it is due.
slots.insight1Body: Every new hire adds fifty micro-decisions to your weekly load.
slots.insight2Body: Playing a role for investors erodes the craft that built you.
slots.insight3Body: Lower cortisol correlates directly with clearer product strategy.
slots.pullQuote: You cannot meditate your way out of a business model that hates you.

slots.title: Work less
slots.subtitle: A four-day week is not a perk when margin is engineered from day one.
slots.insight1Body: Four focused days outperform five fragmented ones every time.
slots.insight2Body: AI handles support and ops; I handle vision and voice.
slots.insight3Body: Stepping away forces systems that survive without founder heroics.
slots.pullQuote: The best product feature I shipped this year was my own absence.

slots.title: Profit is
slots.subtitle: Revenue is vanity, profit is sanity, and cash flow is king at $30k.
slots.insight1Body: I have never touched venture capital, so I have never touched panic.
slots.insight2Body: Solo structure keeps more of every dollar than startup equity paper.
slots.insight3Body: Reinvesting $20k monthly into index funds beats lottery IPO odds.
slots.pullQuote: A calm P&L is the only dashboard I check before coffee.

slots.title: AI scales
slots.subtitle: One operator plus intelligent tooling equals what once required twenty.
slots.insight1Body: API costs drop while output quality rises; the curve favors small.
slots.insight2Body: A narrow AI tool for few beats a platform for everyone.
slots.insight3Body: Agents resolve ninety percent of tickets while I sleep or write.
slots.pullQuote: I am not building the next OpenAI. I am building my next decade.

slots.title: Cap it
slots.subtitle: Six rules for building a calm company in an era that worships chaos.
slots.insight1Body: Define enough before ambition redefines it for you.
slots.insight2Body: Contractors preserve optionality; employees inherit your anxiety.
slots.insight3Body: Every new feature is a new boss; curate the roadmap ruthlessly.
slots.pullQuote: The moment you define enough, you have already won.

slots.ctaBody: Calm businesses are not failures of ambition. They are intelligent designs for a life well-funded and well-lived.
